Hi Caroline —

Thanks for the quick call yesterday. To get Lumina live in our procurement system and enable POs + ACH payments, we need a small packet of documents and a few pieces of metadata from your side. Below is the minimal buyer intake checklist our ops team requires; if you can return these by end of week we can route a PO for the initial pilot.

Required (ideal to send as PDFs):
- Completed W-9 (legal entity name must match bank docs) [Attachment: W9_LuminaPayments.pdf]
- Bank details for remit (account name, account number, routing / SWIFT if outside US) [Attachment: Lumina_Bank_Form.pdf]
- Company resolution or signatory letter (if the person signing the PO is not on the articles) [Attachment: Lumina_Company_Resolution.pdf]
- Legal entity full name, DBA if any, and physical address
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (format: XX-XXXXXXX) and state of incorporation

Procurement routing details we need to populate in our ERP:
- Primary billing contact (name/email/phone)
- Preferred remit method: ACH or Wire (and currency)
- Net payment terms requested (Net 30, Net 45, Net 60)
- PO approval threshold for automatic routing (if you need POs for every invoice or only >$5k)

A couple of notes for clarity:
- Our standard vendor form requires the bank account name to match the legal entity on the W-9; otherwise accounting flags for manual review and ACH will be delayed.
- If you prefer wire for the first payment, please include SWIFT/BIC and an intermediary bank if applicable.

Once we receive items above, I will: 1) open the vendor record with Finance, 2) tag the account with the Platform Integrations cost center (3302), and 3) route the initial PO (PO will be in USD).

If any of these items require a DocuSign instead of a PDF, say the word and I’ll send the envelope.

Thanks —
